spans.s:
एहि एहि (imperative of rt. 5. इ with आ),
come!

एहिमाय एहिमाय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved., = अहि-
माय, q. v., an epithet of the Viśvedevās; (Sāy.) of
all-pervading intelligence; or these deities may be so
named because they uttered on one occasion the words
‘Come near, do not go away’ (एहि मा यासीः. See
Ṛg-veda 1. 3, 9).
